---
name: Issuer request
about: Ask to add your signing key to the verified issuers list (issuers.json)
title: "Issuer request: "
labels: issuer-request
---

Listing is free. A maintainer reviews each request by hand.

**Name to show**

The name a scan should show next to your signed codes.

**Key fingerprint**

The fingerprint Prism Secure shows for your signing key (for example A1B2-C3D4-E5F6-0718). Make the key in Prism Secure and keep the private key safe.

**Link**

A link (site or profile) that the name points to.

**Where is the fingerprint published?**

A link to somewhere you control that shows the same fingerprint. This is what lets people check the list against your own words.

**Anything else**

Optional context for the maintainer.
